# Iron pit

Type: Material | Internal ID: Ironpit | Source: Hildir | Usage: Building | Buy: 75, Coins | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): No

# Introduction

Iron pit is an item which got introduced in the Hildir's Request update and is used to construct the Iron Fire Pit. Iron pit cannot be teleported without a Portal stone.

## Availability

• Purchased from the trader Hildir for 75 Coins a piece.

### Building

• Iron Fire Pit

Categorias: Materials, Can't be Teleported
